summary: Phase 6 activates the exact supported v2 constitution in the live repository and new-project seeds, preserves default PRD/design and SQL approval triggers, and updates server/client projections so implementation commits request a separate conversational confirmation only when the authenticated commit fact requires it. Client instructions continue to stop for every returned presentation and preserve all migration, policy, waiver, drift, restoration, attempts-exhausted, baseline-adoption, and cancellation boundaries. Default scaffolding now proves v2 authority; explicit legacy-v1 fixtures preserve mandatory-gate coverage. Activation-facing documentation and the tracked release payload were updated without installing anything machine-global. The independent implementation review returned no findings. Required focused, unit, contract, integration, crash, type, schema, release reproducibility, and diff-hygiene checks passed. The aggregate check passed 2,037 tests and failed only the documented host-selection digest assertion because its archived authenticated real-host evidence still names the previous rebuilt manifest; that evidence was deliberately not rewritten without rerunning the opt-in real-host suite.
